description: This file defines data structures, constants, and interfaces related to filesystem information and contexts for container runtimes such as Docker, Podman, and Crio, used in cAdvisor for monitoring filesystem metrics.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Holds runtime context for Docker, Crio, and Podman environments.

classes.name: DockerContext
classes.description: Contains configuration details for Docker runtime.

classes.name: PodmanContext
classes.description: Contains configuration details for Podman runtime.

classes.name: CrioContext
classes.description: Contains configuration details for Crio runtime.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: Represents device identification with device name and major/minor numbers.

classes.name: FsType
classes.description: String type representing filesystem types, with constants for specific types.

classes.name: Fs
classes.description: Represents filesystem details including device info, type, capacity, free space, inodes, and disk statistics.

classes.name: DiskStats
classes.description: Holds disk I/O statistics for a filesystem.

classes.name: UsageInfo
classes.description: Contains byte and inode usage metrics.

methods.name: FsType.String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the FsType.
